mapper.select: SELECT e.equip_code, e.equip_name, e.status, st.code_name AS status_name, s.started_at AS status_since, d.dt_cat, cat.code_name AS dt_cat_name, d.dt_sub, sub.code_name AS dt_sub_name, d.started_at AS stop_started_at, last.collected_at AS last_seen_at, last.cycle_count, last.spindle_vibration, last.spindle_temp FROM equipment e OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 started_at FROM equipment_status_log WHERE equip_code = e.equip_code AND ended_at IS NULL ORDER BY started_at DESC ) s OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 dt_cat, dt_sub, started_at FROM downtime WHERE equip_code = e.equip_code AND source = 'EQUIP' AND ended_at IS NULL ORDER BY started_at DESC ) d OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 collected_at, cycle_count, spindle_vibration, spindle_temp FROM equipment_data WHERE equip_code = e.equip_code ORDER BY collected_at DESC ) last LEFT JOIN common_code st ON st.group_code = 'EQUIP_STATUS' AND st.code = e.status LEFT JOIN common_code cat ON cat.group_code = 'DT_CAT' AND cat.code = d.dt_cat LEFT JOIN common_code sub ON sub.group_code = 'DT_SUB' AND sub.code = d.dt_sub WHERE e.auto_collect = 'Y' ORDER BY e.equip_code
SELECT alarm_id, equip_code, alarm_type, measured_value, limit_value, occurred_at FROM equipment_alarm WHERE ack_at IS NULL ORDER BY occurred_at DESC

WITH reason AS ( SELECT d.dt_cat,
d.dt_sub, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(30)) AS dt_sub,
COUNT(*) AS stop_count, SUM(d.duration_min) AS total_min FROM downtime d WHERE d.started_at >= #{from} AND d.started_at < #{to} AND d.duration_min IS NOT NULL
AND d.equip_code = #{equipCode}
GROUP BY d.dt_cat, d.dt_sub ) SELECT r.dt_cat, cat.code_name AS dt_cat_name, r.dt_sub, sub.code_name AS dt_sub_name, r.stop_count, r.total_min, SUM(r.total_min) OVER (ORDER BY r.total_min DESC, r.dt_cat, r.dt_sub ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_min, SUM(r.total_min) OVER () AS grand_total_min FROM reason r LEFT JOIN common_code cat ON cat.group_code = 'DT_CAT' AND cat.code = r.dt_cat LEFT JOIN common_code sub ON sub.group_code = 'DT_SUB' AND sub.code = r.dt_sub ORDER BY r.total_min DESC, r.dt_cat, r.dt_sub
SELECT CAST(MAX(started_at) AS DATE) FROM downtime
